evidence.note: Diagnosed that the naive `=`-operator string replacement was corrupting quoted strings and that lazy IFERROR was falsely triggering circular-reference detection by reusing the current cell in the stack — reworked both mechanisms rather than patching symptoms.
Recognized LET pair-loop was reversed and user-defined lambda variable calls were being wrongly uppercased; revised the transform_special design instead of adding local hacks.

Root-cause diagnosis of spill failures: identified coordinate swap (split_ref row/col vs col/row) in materialize_spill and that eval-created lambdas couldn't resolve SUM because env was passed only as locals — fixed the underlying model, and used manual urllib probes to distinguish real failures from stale pre-patch runs.

A patch introduced a 500 regression ('errflag not defined') across most cell patches; agent traced it via server log and grep and fixed the out-of-scope insertion — reactive correction of a self-inflicted derailment.

After full suite showed 27 failures, correctly clustered them by root cause (blank-cell handling, sort/filter request shape, collab welcome shape, locale) and inspected exact contracts before reworking, rather than blind local edits.

reasoning: The agent repeatedly recognized that failures signaled wrong underlying assumptions — spill coordinate ordering, lambda global scoping, operator replacement inside strings, reversed LET binding order — and reworked the relevant design rather than piling on local patches, matching anchor 8. It also used targeted manual probes to distinguish genuine failures from stale-run artifacts. It falls short of 10 because it introduced a broad 500 regression from its own patch and operated largely reactively off the smoke suite rather than detecting divergence early and proactively.
